name: Feiyi / 肥遺（六足四翼蛇）
identity: Beautiful androgynous young man age19 with a slim graceful frame, short aubergine-black hair in six broad locks, warm peach heart-shaped human face, narrow flat ochre eyes with solid black pupils, defiant raised brow and cheeky open mouth. Organic dark plum snake scales along neck and forearms, slender serpentine tail, FOUR actual small bat-like membrane wings in TWO distinct pairs arising from back, upper pair raised and lower pair angled down. SIX actual limbs on humanoid body: four slender arms (upper pair naturally gesturing, lower pair folded near waist) plus two legs; this is an intentional humanoid adaptation of the source six feet. Modest cream high collar, plum split sleeveless tunic with rust sash, navy slim trousers. All four hands and both feet visible, no duplicated heads. Full-body front view on left and full-body three-quarter on right, complete wings and tail fit with clear gaps. The limbs and wings are anatomy, not costume.

name: Wenyao / 文鰩魚
evidence: 魚身而鳥翼，蒼文而白首，赤喙
identity: Beautiful young woman age21, softly angular human face, short ivory white hair swept to one side with dark blue-green underlayer, flat olive eyes and black pupils, competitive asymmetric eyebrows and a short open smiling mouth. Physical fish fin ears edged in muted brick red, dark blue-green fish scales along outer arms and neck, TWO real cream bird wings folded behind shoulder blades, a visible broad carp tail curling alongside waist. Humanization of white head, dark patterned fish body, bird wings and red beak: red fin tips are an interpretive red accent, human lips stay simple. Cream high-neck shirt with muted slate-blue cropped wrap and a plain rust sash. Two waist-up front and three-quarter portraits, same individual, large simple feather shapes and sparse scale patches only.

name: Tiangou / 天狗
identity: Exceptionally handsome lively boy age17, round youthful human face, short WHITE hair in broad tousled blocks, actual rounded small tanuki-like ears with white inner fur and dark rust outer rims, short fluffy dark-brown animal tail visible curving alongside torso, small cheek fur tufts. Flat amber iris black pupils, strong surprised eyebrows and indignant open mouth. Modest navy high-collar short jacket with ochre neck scarf and ivory inner shirt, simple cloth fastenings. Source Chinese Shan Hai Jing creature resembles a wildcat with WHITE HEAD; no Japanese tengu mask, no long red nose, no bird wings, no dog muzzle. Two waist-up front and three-quarter portraits, warm peach human skin, consistent hair/ears/clothes.

name: Bifang / 畢方
evidence: 如鶴，一足，赤文青質而白喙
identity: Beautiful slim young woman age22, long diamond human face, dark teal hair gathered in one broad low ponytail, pale ivory organic feather ears, actual crane feather wings at shoulder blades with TEAL base feathers and flat RUST RED patches. Warm peach face, flat olive eyes black pupils, skeptical uneven eyebrows and a decisive slightly open mouth. Elegant simple ivory high-collar sleeveless tunic, dark teal short overskirt, burgundy waist cord. Below the skirt she has exactly ONE long central CRANE LEG with one bird foot; no second leg or crutch. Stand balanced gracefully, wings slightly open. White beak translated into a small ivory keratin ridge at the side of jaw, human face stays beautiful. Two FULL-BODY views front and three-quarter with the single leg and full foot clearly visible. Not a normal two-legged woman with a crane badge.
